title: PRILOSEC OTC (omeprazole magnesium) tablet, delayed release: Drug Facts
journal: US over-the-counter drug labelling, published in DailyMed (National Library of Medicine); structured product label version 18, effective 5 October 2026
funder: not stated; the label carries no funding statement
result: Use: frequent heartburn, occurring 2 or more days a week; not for immediate relief; full effect may take 1 to 4 days. Directions for adults: one tablet before eating in the morning every day for 14 days; a 14-day course may be repeated every 4 months; do not take for more than 14 days or more often than every 4 months unless directed by a doctor. Ask a doctor before use with heartburn for over 3 months, unexplained weight loss, frequent wheezing, nausea, vomiting or stomach pain. Stop use and ask a doctor if more than 14 days or more than one course every 4 months is needed, or with diarrhoea, rash or joint pain. Allergy alert: omeprazole may cause severe skin reactions.
